about: compiler/cmd/ergo: zero-leakage help pages, unified flag dispatch, retired Go-tier rejection, and wired fmt/check commands (SELFHOST-DRIVER-CLI).

mutants.name: driver-cli-help-leaks-native-flag
mutants.rule: Primary CLI help must never expose retired Go/backend-tier flags like --native.

mutants.name: driver-cli-help-drops-examples-group
mutants.rule: General --help includes grouped Examples:, Core:, Verify & Inspect:, and Packages & Workspace: sections.

mutants.name: driver-cli-dispatch-accepts-retired-native
mutants.from: return FlagError{Code: 2, Message: "ergo check: unknown option " + arg}
mutants.rule: Unknown and retired backend flags (--native, --compiled, --target, -go-text, --go-trace) fail with exit code 2 instead of being treated as positional paths.

mutants.name: driver-cli-dispatch-omits-default-discovery
mutants.rule: Omitted target paths resolve cleanly via driver.ResolveTargetDefault (. vs ./...).

mutants.name: driver-cli-fmt-check-exits-zero
mutants.rule: ergo fmt --check exits 1 whenever any file differs from canonical format.

mutants.name: driver-cli-check-drops-expr-diags
mutants.rule: ergo check reports expression type and binding diagnostics from compiler/check/expr.

mutants.name: driver-cli-check-cycle-silent
mutants.from:
case driver.CycleError as ce:
		emitCheckFailure(opts.Json, driver.FormatCycle(ce), "E_CYCLE", "")
		return 1
mutants.to:
case driver.CycleError as ce:
		emitCheckFailure(opts.Json, driver.FormatCycle(ce), "E_CYCLE", "")
		return 0
mutants.rule: ergo check rejects import cycles with exit code 1.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-cmd-test-accepts-retired-native
mutants.from: return FlagError{Code: 2, Message: "ergo test: unknown option " + arg}
mutants.rule: ergo test rejects unknown and retired backend flags with exit code 2.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-cmd-test-unmatched-filter-passes
mutants.rule: When --filter matches zero tests/laws across selected targets, ergo test fails with exit code 1.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-cmd-build-accepts-retired-native
mutants.from: return FlagError{Code: 2, Message: "ergo build: unknown option " + arg}
mutants.rule: ergo build rejects unknown and retired backend flags with exit code 2.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-cmd-run-drops-forwarded-args
mutants.rule: ergo run forwards all trailing child flags after PATH or -- untouched.

mutants.name: selfhost-test-runner-cmd-run-masks-child-exit
mutants.rule: ergo run propagates the executed child program's exit status.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-dispatch-routes-lint-to-stub
mutants.rule: DispatchExec routes ergo lint directly to RunLint instead of falling through to the stub hook.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-dispatch-drops-lint-config-guard
mutants.rule: ParseUnifiedOptions sets LintConfigSet and rejects duplicate --lint-config flags.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-lint-strict-ignored
mutants.rule: ergo lint --strict treats warning findings as policy failures.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-lint-gate-comparison-flipped
mutants.rule: ergo lint --gate P fails whenever a finding precision equals or exceeds P.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-fix-check-exits-zero
mutants.rule: ergo fix --check exits 1 when formatting or lint fixes are pending.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-fix-check-writes-files
mutants.rule: ergo fix --check never writes modified source files to disk.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-mutants-list-skips-early-return
mutants.rule: ergo mutants --list outputs the execution plan and returns 0 without running baseline/mutant commands.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-mutants-survival-exits-zero
mutants.rule: ergo mutants exits 1 whenever any hand mutant survives.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-verify-drops-lint-strict
mutants.rule: ergo verify passes --strict to its lint pipeline stage.

mutants.name: selfhost-cli-wire-verify-continues-past-failed-stage
mutants.rule: ergo verify short-circuits remaining stages after a failed stage.
